# API Contract

All endpoints are under `/api/v1`.

## Prediction response

```json
{
  "status": "Possible Leak",
  "leak_probability": 0.87,
  "severity": "High",
  "suspected_zone": "Zone 4",
  "abnormal_sensors": [],
  "main_reason": "Pressure decreased while incoming flow increased.",
  "recommended_action": "A technician should inspect the suspected zone.",
  "warning": "This is an AI-generated early warning, not a confirmed leak. Technician verification is required.",
  "data_mode": "demo",
  "data_timestamp": "2018-01-04T03:00:00",
  "prediction_timestamp": "generated by API",
  "model_version": "demo-static-1.0",
  "schema_version": "1.0.0"
}
```

## Error format

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "MODEL_NOT_AVAILABLE",
    "message": "An approved model is not available. Use Demo Mode or complete model training."
  },
  "request_id": "..."
}
```

Stack traces and sensitive values are never returned.
